statement.ru: Статуя Свободы держит факел в левой руке.
statement.en: The Statue of Liberty holds her torch in her left hand.

why: The torch is in her right hand; the left holds a tablet.

statement.ru: Пизанская башня — это колокольня.
statement.en: The Leaning Tower of Pisa is a bell tower.

why: It is the campanile, the freestanding bell tower, of Pisa Cathedral.

statement.ru: Тадж-Махал построили как дворец, в котором жил правитель.
statement.en: The Taj Mahal was built as a palace for a ruler to live in.

why: It is a mausoleum Shah Jahan built for his wife Mumtaz Mahal.

statement.ru: Однажды стая скворцов, усевшись на стрелку, заставила часы Биг-Бена отстать.
statement.en: A flock of starlings once made Big Ben's clock run slow by sitting on its hand.

why: On 12 August 1949 starlings on the minute hand slowed the clock by 4.5 minutes.

statement.ru: Небоскрёб Эмпайр-стейт-билдинг строили больше десяти лет.
statement.en: The Empire State Building took over ten years to build.

why: It opened 13.5 months after construction started (March 1930 to May 1931).

statement.ru: Самая большая по объёму пирамида в мире стоит в Мексике.
statement.en: The world's largest pyramid by volume is in Mexico.

why: The Great Pyramid of Cholula is the largest pyramid by volume known.

statement.ru: На горе Рашмор высечены лица пяти президентов США.
statement.en: Mount Rushmore shows the faces of five US presidents.

why: There are four: Washington, Jefferson, Theodore Roosevelt and Lincoln.

statement.ru: Версаль начинался с маленького охотничьего домика.
statement.en: The Palace of Versailles began as a small hunting lodge.

why: Louis XIII built a modest hunting lodge there in 1623; Louis XIV grew it into the palace.

statement.ru: Колизей в плане — идеальный круг.
statement.en: Seen from above, the Colosseum is a perfect circle.

why: It is elliptical, 189 by 156 metres.

statement.ru: Архитектор Сиднейской оперы так и не увидел её достроенной.
statement.en: The Sydney Opera House's architect never saw it finished.

why: Jørn Utzon left in 1966 and never returned to Australia to see the completed building.

statement.ru: В небоскрёбе «Тайбэй 101» висит огромный шар, который гасит качку.
statement.en: The Taipei 101 skyscraper has a giant hanging ball that damps its sway.

why: Its tuned mass damper, a huge steel ball, hangs between floors 87 and 92.

statement.ru: Замок Нойшванштайн построили рыцари в Средние века.
statement.en: Neuschwanstein Castle was built by knights in the Middle Ages.

why: It was built from 1869 for King Ludwig II, only imitating medieval castles.

statement.ru: Атомиум в Брюсселе — это огромная модель молекулы воды.
statement.en: Brussels' Atomium is a giant model of a water molecule.

why: Its nine spheres form a unit cell of an iron crystal, magnified 165 billion times.

statement.ru: Ход часов Биг-Бена подправляют, кладя на маятник монетки.
statement.en: Big Ben's clock is adjusted by putting coins on its pendulum.

why: Old pennies on the pendulum are added or removed to correct the time.

statement.ru: Пизанскую башню выпрямили, и теперь она стоит ровно.
statement.en: The Leaning Tower of Pisa has been straightened and now stands upright.

why: Works in 1993-2001 only cut the lean to about 4 degrees; it still leans clearly.

statement.ru: Наполеон увёз колесницу с Бранденбургских ворот в Париж.
statement.en: Napoleon took the chariot from the Brandenburg Gate to Paris.

why: In 1806 Napoleon took the Quadriga to Paris; it came back after 1814.

statement.ru: Белый дом покрасили в белый, чтобы скрыть следы пожара.
statement.en: The White House was painted white to hide fire damage.

why: A myth: it was whitewashed from the 1790s and called 'White House' by 1811, before the 1814 fire.

statement.ru: Великая пирамида в Гизе когда-то была гладкой и белой.
statement.en: The Great Pyramid of Giza was once smooth and white.

why: It was covered in smooth white Tura limestone casing, mostly removed later.

statement.ru: Статую Христа над Рио-де-Жанейро отлили из бронзы.
statement.en: The Christ the Redeemer statue above Rio was cast in bronze.

why: It is reinforced concrete covered with soapstone.

statement.ru: Солнце, отражённое лондонским небоскрёбом, однажды оплавило машину.
statement.en: Sunlight reflected off a London skyscraper once melted parts of a parked car.

why: In 2013 the 'Walkie-Talkie' focused sunlight and melted parts of a Jaguar.

statement.ru: Писающий мальчик в Брюсселе выше взрослого человека.
statement.en: The Manneken Pis statue in Brussels is taller than a grown man.

why: The bronze boy is just 55.5 cm tall.

statement.ru: Замок Святого Ангела в Риме строили как гробницу императора.
statement.en: Rome's Castel Sant'Angelo was built as an emperor's tomb.

why: It was built as the Mausoleum of Hadrian, later turned into a fortress.

statement.ru: Сиднейский оперный театр построили к Олимпиаде 2000 года.
statement.en: The Sydney Opera House was built for the 2000 Olympics.

why: It opened in 1973, 27 years before the Sydney Olympics.

statement.ru: У Писающего мальчика около тысячи костюмов.
statement.en: The Manneken Pis has about a thousand costumes.

why: He is dressed up regularly; his wardrobe holds around 1,000 costumes, with its own museum.

statement.ru: Эмпайр-стейт-билдинг — самое высокое здание Нью-Йорка.
statement.en: The Empire State Building is the tallest building in New York.

why: One World Trade Center (541 m) is the tallest in New York and the USA.

statement.ru: Под Триумфальной аркой в Париже однажды пролетел самолёт.
statement.en: A plane once flew through the Arc de Triomphe in Paris.

why: Charles Godefroy flew a biplane under the arch on 7 August 1919.

statement.ru: Статую Свободы привезли в Америку целиком, не разбирая.
statement.en: The Statue of Liberty was shipped to America in one piece.

why: It was taken apart and shipped in crates on the Isère, then reassembled.

statement.ru: Кёльнский собор когда-то был самым высоким зданием в мире.
statement.en: Cologne Cathedral was once the tallest building in the world.

why: At 157 m it was the world's tallest building from 1880 to 1884.

statement.ru: В Британии законом запрещено умирать в здании парламента.
statement.en: In Britain it is against the law to die in the Houses of Parliament.

why: A myth: the Law Commission (2013) found no such law; people have died there.

statement.ru: Лондонский Тауэр — это одна высокая башня.
statement.en: The Tower of London is a single tall tower.

why: It is a castle with walls and many towers around the central White Tower.

statement.ru: Собор Парижской Богоматери построили меньше чем за двадцать лет.
statement.en: Notre-Dame de Paris was built in under twenty years.

why: It was built from 1163 to 1345, nearly two centuries.

statement.ru: Президентов на горе Рашмор собирались высечь по пояс.
statement.en: The Mount Rushmore presidents were meant to be carved down to the waist.

why: Each was to be shown head to waist, but funding ran out in 1941.

statement.ru: В сказочном замке Нойшванштайн был телефон.
statement.en: The fairy-tale castle of Neuschwanstein had a telephone.

why: Built in the 1870s-80s, it had telephone lines, an electric bell system and central heating.

statement.ru: Собор Святой Софии в Стамбуле изначально строили как мечеть.
statement.en: Hagia Sophia in Istanbul was first built as a mosque.

why: It was built as a Christian cathedral in 537 and became a mosque only in 1453.

statement.ru: В лондонском Тауэре держат воронов: по легенде, без них падёт королевство.
statement.en: The Tower of London keeps ravens: legend says the kingdom falls without them.

why: At least six ravens live there; legend says if they leave, the Crown will fall.

statement.ru: Белый дом больше Букингемского дворца.
statement.en: The White House is bigger than Buckingham Palace.

why: Buckingham Palace has 775 rooms; the White House residence has 132.

statement.ru: Архитектор Гауди погиб, попав под трамвай.
statement.en: The architect Gaudí died after being hit by a tram.

why: In 1926 a Barcelona tram struck him; he died three days later.

statement.ru: Пирамиды Гизы стоят в глубокой пустыне, далеко от городов.
statement.en: The Giza pyramids stand deep in the desert, far from any city.

why: They are at the desert's edge inside the city of Giza, 13 km from central Cairo.

statement.ru: В одном французском замке есть лестница из двух спиралей, которые не встречаются.
statement.en: A French château has a staircase of two spirals that never meet.

why: Chambord's double-helix staircase: two spirals climb three floors without meeting.
